SELECT r.student_id, r.theme_id, r.theme_week_start, COALESCE(t.published_version_id, t.current_version_id) AS theme_version_id, min(r.awarded_at) AS awarded_at FROM ( SELECT p.student_id, p.theme_id, p.theme_week_start, max(p.completed_at) AS awarded_at FROM ( SELECT a.student_id, a.theme_id, a.theme_week_start, d.day_of_week, min(a.completed_at) AS completed_at FROM attempt a JOIN weekly_theme t ON t.id = a.theme_id JOIN weekly_theme_day d ON d.theme_version_id = COALESCE(a.theme_version_id, t.published_version_id, t.current_version_id) AND d.mission_id = a.mission_id WHERE GROUP BY a.student_id, a.theme_id, a.theme_week_start, d.day_of_week ) p GROUP BY p.student_id, p.theme_id, p.theme_week_start HAVING count(*) = 5 UNION ALL SELECT c.student_id, c.theme_id, c.theme_week_start, max(c.completed_at) AS awarded_at FROM ( SELECT a.student_id, a.theme_id, a.theme_week_start, a.mission_id, min(a.completed_at) AS completed_at FROM attempt a WHERE GROUP BY a.student_id, a.theme_id, a.theme_week_start, a.mission_id ) c JOIN weekly_theme t ON t.id = c.theme_id JOIN weekly_theme_day d ON d.theme_version_id = COALESCE(t.published_version_id, t.current_version_id) AND d.mission_id = c.mission_id GROUP BY c.student_id, c.theme_id, c.theme_week_start HAVING count(*) = 5 ) r JOIN weekly_theme t ON t.id = r.theme_id GROUP BY r.student_id, r.theme_id, r.theme_week_start, t.published_version_id, t.current_version_id
